label: LTX Alpha Gen
description: LTX-2.5 IC-LoRA alpha matte from a plate - or from a cropped area of it, for more model resolution on the subject. Output: matte at plate frame numbers, shown in the full plate frame.
usage: Makes an alpha matte for a frame range (LTX-2.5 Alpha Gen).
Whole input range is sent; tick 'input range' to send only first-last.
Crop: tick 'crop' and move the box in the viewer to send only that area (more detail on small fixes).
output: the matte, or the input with the matte as alpha. Lower 'work scale' for long or big plates.
Bring in output builds Read > Crop (> Undo crop) > Shuffle.
highlights: what the model sees. 'clip' (default) cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open. 'roll off' compresses highlights but crushes deep shadows.

License (checked 2026-11): LTX-2.x Community - commercial use is free under $10M annual revenue (affiliates count); above that needs a paid license. Generated content must be disclosed as machine-generated when distributed.

max_frames_input.tooltip: The model card says 145: above that RGB detail can leak into the matte. Check the result if you go higher.

knobs.name: work_scale
knobs.label: work scale
knobs.tooltip: Working size inside the 1920x1088 limit (1.0 = largest that fits). Lower = faster, softer matte; with a small crop you can raise it.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: What the model sees; only the input changes, as the matte is data and isn't converted back. clip (default): values above 1 become 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. roll off: the plate goes in through ACES Output - sRGB, so highlights are compressed instead of cut, but deep shadows are crushed. Try roll off for edges against blown-out backgrounds, such as hair against sky; keep clip for dark edges on dark backgrounds.
